column1: # DigitalPet — custom partition table (16 MB flash).
# Replaces the ESP-IDF default single-app table
# partition and left ~14 MB of the chip unused. The app was already at ~850 KB
# (83% full) with only the display + BLE in it; audio (M4/M5) and animation
#  - Two 3 MB OTA app slots: ~3.5x the headroom
#    become possible later without a second
#    (No factory partition: with otadata blank the bootloader runs ota_0
#  - ~9.8 MB `assets` partition for pet artwork — sprite/frame sequences can be
#    dropped there and swapped without reflashing the firmware.
# App partitions must start on a 64 KB boundary.
